catalogue_entry.name: models/gemini-2.5-flash
catalogue_entry.description: Stable version of Gemini 2.5 Flash, our mid-size multimodal model that supports up to 1 million tokens, released in June of 2025.

ground_1_design_or_examination_seat.basis: The instrument and specification were designed/examined by the Remmy seat (Claude lineage) and the Vane seat (ChatGPT lineage) in recorded sessions. None of the three pinned models is either seat's model, and none served in any recorded design, drafting, or examination session for this instrument.

ground_2_material_supplied_in_recorded_s.basis: No recorded session supplied Annex C, Annex D, the six-region fixture, accepted-run histories, prior trial outputs (none exist), or this brief's scoring provisions to any of the three pinned models.

ground_3_provider_documents_training_use.result: not exposed on the documents read
ground_3_provider_documents_training_use.basis: No provider document read for these routes states that this material forms part of the pinned model version's training or fine-tuning data. Groq's Services Agreement bars training use of inputs/outputs absent explicit permission. Google's free-tier terms permit Google to use API content to improve its products: that concerns content submitted through the API going forward, is not documentation that the pinned version was trained on this material, and is recorded here so the certificate says exactly what it covers. What is certified is absence of KNOWN or DEMONSTRABLE exposure on these grounds, not the metaphysical absence of any possible exposure (Rev 4 SS8).
